name: O-Bot The Robot: Re-Botted
storyline:
O-Bot and his friend Spade were at the park, trying out the new propeller in O-Bot's cap that Spade made for him. That was until they heard an explosion from afar. And O-Bot being curious, he decided to check it out, despite that being potentiontionally dangerous, and Spade couldn't catch up with him. They find out that their planet is infested with so-called "Miniframes" and other invasive bots.

Later they have to clean up the whole place from them and fight with whoever sent the invasive bots over there.
summary:
O-Bot The Robot: Re-Botted is a 2D platformer with singlep layer gameplay

The concept is simple: Go right, destroy enemies by jumping on their heads/antennas, and reach the end of the level where a wooden sign with an arrow is waiting for you.
